critical_code_review_comments: BlogManager.jsx: the topics textarea has onBlur=saveTopics AND the 'Save ideas' button calls saveTopics — clicking the button after typing fires two PUTs and two success toasts. Harmless/idempotent but consider guarding (skip save when draft is unchanged).

PATCH /api/admin/blog/{id}/publish takes a raw dict body instead of a Pydantic model; non-bool/absent 'published' silently defaults to True. Low risk since bool() coerces, but a small PublishInput model would be cleaner/validated.
Custom topics are consumed by value ([t for t in customs if t != consumed]); duplicates are deduped on save so this is safe today, but index-based removal would be more robust.
